President, PM Congratulate Hockey Teams on Asia Cup Wins

President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the Indian junior men's and women's hockey teams on their respective Asia Cup triumphs. The Prime Minister described the victories as a "proud moment" for the nation. Specific details about the matches or the opponents were not provided in the coverage.
